title: Agora
tagline: Decentralized embeddable comment application , Owners of the websites can be able to crawl their website content and submit publications  as NFT.
description: We are building a decentralized commenting widget that can be embedded on any web2 or web3 website. Using their wallet, users can create their own profile where they can manage their content. This will allow them to have full ownership of their content. We are also planning on letting users follow other users and to monetize their comments. Owners of the websites can be able to crawl their website content and submit publications  as NFT. Currently we have the prototype of the user login/signup authentication using lens protocol. We plan to continue implementing all features.
how_its_made:
Using Lens Protocol, users can log-in and create their own profile. They can add their comments using Lens Protocol's publications module. See publication post and comments. Follow other users and websites .We are also planning on using the Follow module as well as the Collect module for monetization.
